name: Wei Lim
bio:
Wei Lim's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. Initially working in a hawker stall, his exceptional organizational skills and knack for managing food preparation caught the eye of a local racing team during a track day event. He was offered a trial, and his ability to maintain consistent quality and efficiency, even under pressure, quickly secured him a permanent role.

Wei is dedicated to providing the team with nutritious and delicious meals, understanding the importance of a well-fed crew for peak performance. While still developing his managerial skills, Wei's passion lies in optimizing the catering operation. He is known for his commitment to sourcing fresh, local ingredients whenever possible, even under tight deadlines.

What distinguishes Wei is his unwavering loyalty and meticulous attention to detail. He sees the catering operation as an integral part of the team, ensuring everyone is fueled and ready to perform at their best. Wei strives to improve his cooking techniques and learn new recipes. Wei dreams of one day catering for a Formula 1 team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height and build, with a friendly and approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and ingredient lists.
Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served.
Secretly practices his English vocabulary during downtime.
